title: Mitigating Manipulation and Enhancing Persuasion: A Reflective Multi-Agent Approach for Legal Argument Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on fostering 'ethical persuasion' and 'ethical AI behavior' in legal AI systems. It explicitly benchmarks LLMs on their ability to avoid 'informational manipulation' and their capacity for 'successful abstention' when arguments are untenable, framing these as core ethical requirements for trustworthy AI in the legal domain.
